Name: Beep Brrp Bing Bang Bosh
Overview:
bbbbb is the ungodly rhythm game child of running platformers, Rock Band and gravity flipping.

Each lane controls an instrument, each button controls a character in a lane. Flip characters avoiding the spikes and keep the music going. And every so often there’s the wheel of fortune: characters are moved into new positions. There’s only a few seconds to get ready for the next onslaught.
